{{Quote|Our mother is dying and I have no way to reach her.|Devar Gann|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''mother''' of [[Devar Gann|Devar]] and [[Kindra Gann]] was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. By the year [[3640 BBY]] she was on her deathbed, apparently from old age.
